troglodyte.generation_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production animated character sprite sheet for a dark fantasy side-scrolling game. Generate one landscape 1536x1024 image, exactly SIX equal columns and FOUR equal rows, 24 separate full-body poses of the SAME creature on a genuinely transparent background. No painted checkerboard, labels, borders, cell lines, shadows, ground, scenery, particles or spare items. Each invisible 256x256 cell has 20 pixels of clear space. All poses face LEFT, side-on with a slight three-quarter view. Crisp detailed pixel art with deliberate small clusters, dark outlines, weathered materials and sharp anatomy. Maintain EXACTLY the same body proportions, clothing, equipment and scale across all poses; no per-pose resizing. Keep full tail, limbs, head and weapon entirely within each cell. Grounded feet all contact the same baseline at local y=228, including attack recovery. The x center stays fixed within each cell.
Row 1: six gentle breathing IDLE frames with feet planted. Row 2: six distinct alternating WALK gait phases moving left in place, one supporting foot always on ground. Row 3: six ATTACK phases: ready, windup, beginning strike, full strike, follow-through, return to ready. Row 4: six DEATH phases: ready, recoil, legs buckle, collapse sideways, body settled on ground, final motionless low corpse. Corpse stays fully inside its cell and rests on the same floor baseline. No jumping attacks.

PRIORITY: The crouched posture and long fleshy TAIL must make this unmistakably an inhuman cave creature. Every pose has the tail. Its spine is almost horizontal with head below its shoulders; never an upright bald man. NO eyes.
CREATURE:
The Troglodyte carries its body in a deep, permanent hunch. Its ridged back arches above its low head, and its nearly horizontal torso narrows into a sunken belly between long, folded limbs. The shoulders rise like blunt knobs beneath pale gray-green skin. A wet film gathers in strings below the elbows and in the loose folds around its throat. Its broad, flattened head projects from the chest without an upright neck. Wrinkled skin seals both eye depressions beneath a heavy brow; a wide nose and a split-looking mouth full of uneven teeth occupy the blunt face.

Large cupped ears flare sideways, one folded along the rim. Its oversized hands almost reach the floor, with long fingers and hooked, dirty nails. Deeply bent hind legs end in broad splayed feet. A thick, tapering, hairless tail grows from the base of its spine and curves behind the body, its fleshy folds slick with the same slime as its back. A ragged strip of hide covers its hips beneath the tail root. Chalk dust cakes its toes and knuckles. It holds one probing hand ahead of its face and cocks its head as though waiting for an objection from the wall, while its tail makes a slow balancing curve behind it.

IDLE: Its arched back rises slightly with each breath while its head stays low. Both splayed feet remain planted; the fingers of its probing hand curl and release as the fleshy tail shifts gently behind it for balance.
ATTACK: It compresses its folded legs and draws one long arm beneath its chest, then thrusts its low shoulders forward into a broad clawing rake. The tail curls the other way to balance the strike. Its front foot braces before the arm withdraws and the body settles into its deep listening crouch.
AVOID: upright human posture; visible eyeballs or glowing eye sockets; hair; reptilian scales; carried weapons; missing tail; exposed genitals; a cheerful expression

No painted checkerboard, labels, borders, cell lines, shadows, ground, scenery, particles or spare items. Each invisible 256x256 cell has 20 pixels of clear space. All poses face LEFT, side-on with a slight three-quarter view. Crisp detailed pixel art with deliberate small clusters, dark outlines, weathered materials and sharp anatomy. Maintain EXACTLY the same body proportions, clothing, equipment and scale across all poses; no per-pose resizing. Keep full tail, limbs, head and weapon entirely within each cell. Row 4: six DEATH phases: ready, recoil, legs buckle, collapse sideways, body settled on ground, final motionless low corpse. Corpse stays fully inside its cell and rests on the same floor baseline. PRIORITY: The weapon is a single heavy AXE with a clearly curved cutting blade, NEVER a hammer or maul. Bright small RED EYES are clearly visible in all live poses. Entirely bald and beardless, short and abnormally broad. Boots, not axe tip, define the planted ground level; keep axe edge above the soles when resting.
CREATURE:
The Delve Dwarf barely reaches an adult human's chest, but its barrel-shaped torso is nearly as broad as it is tall. A large bald head sits directly between sloping shoulders on a neck almost hidden by thick folds. Its clean-shaven face is broad and flattened, with a low shelf of brow, close-set ember-red eyes, a short blunt nose and a thin horizontal mouth. Small hot-red centers hold steady inside dark, bruised sockets. The jaw is wide and smoothly hairless. Ash-gray skin darkens to violet around the deep creases of its elbows, and chalky dust settles over the crown of its head. Its expression barely changes when the rest of its body moves.

Bulky forearms hang beside the compressed torso, ending in large square hands with thick fingers. Short bowed legs terminate in broad, cracked leather boots. A sleeveless charcoal work tunic, patched leather apron and narrow iron belt enclose its heavy frame; one apron corner has been cut away to stop it catching beneath a knee. It grips a heavy iron axe with a broad crescent blade and a short, dark wooden haft bound in worn leather. Rust pits the cheek of the blade, but its chipped cutting edge has been ground bright. It holds the axe low beside its boot and squares its stance in tiny adjustments, taking considerable trouble to occupy the exact middle of the passage.

IDLE: It breathes through its nose and tightens its square hands around the low axe haft, keeping both short legs firmly planted and its red eyes fixed ahead.
ATTACK: It takes the axe in both hands, bends its short knees and lifts the broad iron blade above one shoulder. Its torso rolls forward into a heavy descending chop while both boots brace against the floor. It pulls the blade back across its body and lowers the axe beside its boot.
AVOID: beard or moustache; head hair; horned helmet; Viking costume; heroic smiling fantasy dwarf; slender build; exposed genitals; giant stature
